versions.content: Service Name Ifl_IpoCub_f32 Syntax float32 Ifl_IpoCub_f32 ( const Ifl_DPResultF32_Type * dpResultX, const Ifl_DPResultF32_Type * dpResultY, const Ifl_DPResultF32_Type * dpResultZ, uint16 num_x, uint16 num_y, const float32 * Val_array ) Service ID [hex] 0x12 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant dpResultX Data point search result for X axis dpResultY Data point search result for Y axis dpResultZ Data point search result for Z axis num_x Number of X axis points num_y Number of Y axis points Parameters (in) Val_array Pointer to the result axis distribution array Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value float32 Result of the interpolation Description Based on searched indices and ratios information using the relevant Ifl_DPSearch_f32 routine, this routine calculates and returns the interpolation result for a 3D cuboid. Available via Ifl.h
